headline: Formosa Group Stocks Surge! Chairman Wu Chia-chau: Next Year Will Be Even Better | Finance | SETN.COM
summary: Formosa Group stocks surged in the second half of the year after years of dormancy. Six group companies reached a combined intraday market capitalization of nearly NT$7.3 trillion.
why: Formosa Plastics and its affiliates are major Taiwanese petrochemical and plastics producers, so their share moves affect Taiwan's industrial stocks and chemical sector.
